answer: Require every agent identity to lock a bonded stake before it can vote or earn. Because the bond is the kernel of its weight, spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds, so a sybil grove of clones gains no extra influence per coin. Bonds sit like basalt: they unlock only after a long delay and are slashed when peers prove duplicate or colluding behavior, so attacker capital stays exposed while fraud is detected, making attacks cost more than they pay.
